payment.q: How do we pay for EduFlow?
payment.a: Platform invoices are handled by the product owner. Online student fees use PayHere only when that feature is on the plan.

trial.q: How does the free trial work?
trial.a: 14 days, no card. When it ends, the institute can still be viewed and stays read-only until a subscription is activated.

export.a: Growth and above can export PDF, CSV, and Excel. An institute backup is a zip of that tenant’s records when backups are enabled.

cancel.a: Ask the product owner to end the subscription. The institute becomes read-only. Your records stay until a support restore or retention job removes them.

price.q: Where do the prices come from?
price.a: From the plans list. If a plan has no monthly price, the page says Contact us.

sms.q: What happens when SMS quota runs out?
sms.a: The default is to send and record the extra segments. An institute can switch that to block instead. Extra segments are priced on the plan.

domain.q: Can we use our own web address?
domain.a: Each institute gets a subdomain. A custom domain is arranged with the product owner.

languages.q: Do you support Tamil and Sinhala?
languages.a: The app, message templates, and SMS length rules support English, Tamil, and Sinhala.

portal.a: Yes. Parent portal off stops parent sign-in and every parent API, and the phone shows a short explanation.

data.q: Is one institute’s data visible to another?
data.a: No. Every record is stored with the institute id and queries are filtered to that institute.

signup.title: Start a 14-day trial
signup.description: No card. You get an institute address, an admin account, and the plan you pick.

signup.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in

attendance.title: Mark attendance
attendance.body: Start the class, then scan the student barcode. A second scan tells you the time of the first mark. Students still unmarked when the class stops can be marked absent if that setting is on.

fees.title: Fees and receipts
fees.body: Fee structures belong to a batch. The monthly job creates one invoice per student and period. Record cash or a bank slip to issue the next receipt number.

exams.title: Exams and ranks
exams.body: Add the paper, enter marks, lock, then publish. Students with the same percentage share a rank. Publishing sends the results message once, if that switch is on.

messages.title: Message switches
messages.body: Each automatic message has its own switch, channel, and template. Turning the switch off skips queued messages as well as new ones. Tamil and Sinhala text uses the shorter Unicode SMS size.

portal.title: Parent portal
portal.body: Link a parent to one or more students. They sign in with a mobile number. If the institute turns the portal off, sign-in and the parent pages stop.

backups.title: Institute backups
backups.body: Backup now, or let the schedule run. The zip holds this institute only. Download it from the backup history. Restore is done by support after a dry run.

plans.title: Plans and limits
plans.body: Student, batch, subject, staff, SMS, and storage limits are enforced when you save. The error names the limit and the maximum. A higher plan, or an extra allowance, is how you go past it.

switches.title: Feature switches
switches.body: A feature works only when the plan includes it and the institute switch is on. Locked features show Upgrade plan. Every switch change is written to the audit log.
